brand.Description:
Identifier of the brand to which this client
is attached to. The format is
'projects/{project_number}/brands/{brand_id}/identityAwareProxyClients/{client_id}'.

client_id.Description: Output only. Unique identifier of the OAuth client.

display_name.Description: Human-friendly name given to the OAuth client.

secret.Description: Output only. Client secret of the OAuth client.
